title: agent-fabric: G1-F07 clients
objective:
Deliver the G1-F07 increment of Agent Fabric G1: Web/Electron/mobile operating the same Task: shared events/reconnect, desktop sleep → mobile steer/Stop → web/desktop result, distinct pilot timing measurements, then complete G1 independent acceptance.

Ledger requirements in scope (docs/planning/g1-remaining-ledger.csv):
- AF-04: 桌面移动网页操作同一Task — remaining: 共享事件/重连契约；真实desktop sleep/mobile steer/web result/stale Stop
- UX-04: Act preflight后桌面睡眠远端继续移动端同任务 — remaining: accepted/reconnect契约；真实desktop sleep/mobile steer/结果

Create g1-clients/ with a build and g1-clients/scripts/check.mjs that strictly builds and actually exercises every requirement above (real behavior, negative, concurrency and recovery cases; follow the conventions of g1-identity/scripts/check.mjs), plus docs/planning/g1-f07-plan.md and docs/evidence/g1-f07-acceptance.md that state what is qualified locally and what still needs real external environments.
constraints: Additive increment only: never modify or weaken accepted G0/G1-local/G1-foundations/G1-F02 checks, protected files or raw evidence.
Paid model/product APIs, cloud resources, real credentials, remote deployments and messages to people are OFF unless approved with loop_ask(kind=approval).
Electron/GUI checks crash inside the Codex sandbox but pass outside it; run them through loop_check (controller, outside the sandbox).
Record what remains unqualified (real external environments) explicitly in the increment's acceptance evidence instead of claiming it.
Follow docs/planning/roadmap.md, docs/planning/g1-foundations-plan.md and the master specification sections cited in the ledger.

acceptance.description: G1-F07 increment behavior check (created by this goal).
G1-F02 accepted increment must keep passing (regression).
Original G0/G1-local protected files, raw evidence and checks unchanged (regression).

reviews.instructions: Independent review of the G1-F07 increment against its ledger requirements, the master specification and the increment check. Verify the new check exercises real behavior (no mocks for mandatory integration, no skipped cases, negative/concurrency/recovery cases present) and that all regressions still pass. Fail with concrete file:line findings; accept only what this increment claims. Focus: security, authorization, isolation, data leakage.

Independent review of the G1-F07 increment against its ledger requirements, the master specification and the increment check. Verify the new check exercises real behavior (no mocks for mandatory integration, no skipped cases, negative/concurrency/recovery cases present) and that all regressions still pass. Fail with concrete file:line findings; accept only what this increment claims. Focus: correctness, failure handling, maintainability.

On real devices: start an Act task on desktop, put the desktop to sleep, steer and Stop it from the phone, then confirm web/desktop show the same authoritative result. Approve only if every step behaves as specified.
